messages:
alex: heads up - seeing increasing gpu-host eviction rates in us-west-2a, started ~09:12 UTC. a few jobs failing with ENI timeouts and agent reconnects.

sre-bot: [alert] gpu-host-eviction-high on us-west-2a (hostpool-gpu). Count=42

maya: copying logs. can you paste the first failing pod logs?

alex: logs: ```ERROR: session lost: KV cache miss, reconnecting
2026-03-17T09:11:45Z network: ENI timeout 504
```

priya: looks like NIC firmware flaps on hostgroup-3. AWS ASG shows several hosts in Terminating:Retry state.

kai: suggest a staggered evac: cordon small batches (5 nodes) -> drain -> wait for autoscaler to refill in other AZs. avoids thundering herd and global throttles. also temporarily bump scale-down delay.

maya: agreed. proposed runbook: 1) reduce incoming weight to us-west-2a (soft shift) 2) cordon nodes a1..a5 3) drain with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` 4) monitor GPU queue length + p99 latency 5) iterate every 10-12m.

alex: doing step 1 now: `trafficctl weights set --region us-west-2 --zone us-west-2a=0.6 --zone us-west-2b=0.2 --zone us-west-2c=0.2 --reason \"evac-proactive\"`

sre-bot: [action] traffic weights updated (us-west-2a=0.6, 2b=0.2, 2c=0.2)

priya: cordoning first batch and draining: `for n in a1 a2 a3 a4 a5; do kubectl cordon $n; kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120; done`

kai: reminder: mark the affected ASG with `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-down-disabled=true` temporarily so the autoscaler doesn't collapse capacity mid-evac. also ensure disruption budgets are respected for critical services.

maya: watching dashboards: GPU pending jobs, pod evictions, and tokenization latency. threshold: if pending > 120 for >10m, we escalate to aggressive failover (set us-west-2a weight to 0.3).

alex: first batch drained clean. autoscaler brought up 4 nodes across 2b/2c, pods rescheduled, latency back to baseline.

priya: second batch scheduled in 12m. note on costs: cross-zone warmups and extra nodes will increase spend for short window — rough estimate +8-12% for the day.

kai: ops checklist for after-action: file firmware update ticket for hostgroup-3, add NIC error metric with alerting at 5/min, and add a \"staggered evac\" runbook to the playbook.

maya: creating incident wrapper: INC-2026-148, attaching logs and the trafficctl commands used.

alex: continuing batches. will post when all nodes in 2a drained or if we need to escalate. :thumbsup:

priya: one more note — some long-running inf jobs may time out during reschedule. setting temporary retry window on job-controller to 30m.

kai: thanks team. after this completes we should schedule a controlled drain drill in staging to validate timing and cost before next incident.

alex: closing update for now, will reopen if we hit >10% job failure or >30m sustained queue.
